tooltip.serverConfig:
MCP server configuration supports modern stdio or Streamable HTTP fields: transport, command/args/env, url/headers, timeouts, private-network opt-in, terminate_on_close, and auth_ref. Unknown or legacy fields are rejected.
⚠️ If you deploy AstrBot using Docker, make sure to install stdio MCP servers in the data directory mounted by AstrBot
